contract.rule: Agent memory is a callable skill/action space below the root Agent, not a parallel global experience system entrypoint.
baseline_from_episode_01: store and retrieve with SQLite/FTS5 before adding vector or graph memory
track temporal validity with created_at, valid_until, and superseded_by
render stable Frozen Snapshots for reusable prompt-prefix memory
consolidate stale, duplicate, or high-priority semantic and procedural records
skill_layer_from_episode_07: search before store when an existing record may already answer or be updated
upsert or supersede instead of unbounded append
retrieve memory on demand instead of injecting the whole store
review complete memory-action traces at save-point boundaries
iterate the scaffold with measured behavior rather than static prompt edits

StoreMemory.preference: use SearchMemory first unless the memory is newly produced by the current verified result
StoreMemory.dedupe: content_sha256 deterministic id plus optional supersedes link

SearchMemory.preference: use before decisions where prior project or global experience can reduce repeated steering
SearchMemory.retrieval: FTS5 first with TTL and supersession filters

ConsolidateMemory.preference: run at closeout or after noisy memory-action traces
effects: freeze high-priority semantic or procedural records

RenderMemorySnapshot.preference: render stable prompt-prefix memory and append dynamic task context after it

metrics.target: < 10 chars per step through upsert, supersession, archive, or snapshot
dedupe through deterministic id or supersession
< 25% with on-demand retrieval and Frozen Snapshot

metrics.baseline_signal: late failure caused by early missed memory
metrics.target: review complete trace at save point and update scaffold or candidate record

trace_review.save_point_rule: review memory_action traces before promoting scaffold changes
trace_review.promotion_rule: verified cross-project memory behavior becomes a candidate or canonical policy; raw private traces never enter Git

no_regression: human, llm, and internal-functional-unit cannot directly mutate Agent memory structure
policy is registered in config/agent-system.json and projected through agent/agent-filesystem.json
no raw private memory content is tracked in Git
